people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Son of Gideon, self-proclaimed king of Shechem

people.name: Beeroth
people.line: Hivite city, later allotted to Benjamin.

people.name: Jotham
people.line: Youngest son of Gideon who escaped Abimelech's massacre

translations.web: Jotham ran away and fled, and went to Beer and lived there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
translations.bsb: Then Jotham ran away, escaping to Beer, and he lived there for fear of his brother Abimelech.
translations.kjv: And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
translations.asv: And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
